key_insight: Near-equilibrium accuracy did not ensure reliable fatigue predictions: foundational NequIP predicted much more plastic deformation than EAM.
engineering_relevance: Validate interatomic potentials under relevant loading conditions before using them to predict fatigue-driven material behavior.
method: Compare EAM and foundational NequIP on near-equilibrium properties.
Simulate fatigue cycling around a nanoscale flaw modeled after a Griffith crack.
evidence_signal: Both potentials closely matched reference data for many near-equilibrium properties, but NequIP predicted roughly sevenfold lower intrinsic stacking fault energy than EAM, with the largest energy-distribution differences far above thermally accessible energies.
watch_item: Without direct experimental validation, the fatigue comparison is not definitive; memory-related crashes and silent extrapolation also warrant caution.
paper_title: Emergent Fatigue Dynamics from Foundational Interatomic Potentials
